pkgmetadata.longdescription: Router client of Errant Solutions ETPH: uses a phone running the ETPH app as this machine's internet connection (WAN) over USB (built-in ADB host, no adb package) or Wi-Fi (TLS). Upstream's static router build (no BlueZ), with an OpenRC script and a systemd unit; settings in /etc/etph/etph.conf.
